user.title: Select your Elga Ace gateway
user.description: Activate Bluetooth/service mode on the appliance and close the Remeha app. Select a gateway seen by a local Bluetooth adapter or an active ESPHome proxy.

pair.title: Name and pair your Elga Ace
pair.description: Gateway: **{address}**. For a local adapter, enter the appliance's PIN below. For an ESPHome proxy, leave it empty and configure the PIN once in the proxy's secrets.yaml using esphome/elga-pairing.yaml. All entities are read-only.

data.name: Device name
data.pin: Local adapter PIN (leave empty for a proxy)

data_description.name: Used as the device name and entity name prefix.
data_description.pin: Used only for local Linux/BlueZ pairing. ESPHome proxies use their own elga_pin secret; this field is not forwarded.

progress.connecting: Pairing, unlocking BLE services, authorizing CAN and the appliance, then verifying an authenticated register read...

error.invalid_name: Enter a device name between 1 and 80 characters.
error.invalid_pin: Enter a local adapter PIN of one to six digits, or leave this field empty when using a proxy.
error.invalid_auth: Bluetooth rejected the pairing code. Check the code on the appliance. After an incorrect code the gateway may need about a minute before another attempt.
error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect. Check service mode, Bluetooth range and free connection slots. For a proxy, check the elga_pin secret and built-in passkey configuration. Close other clients.
error.cannot_read: Connected, but an authenticated register could not be read. Check that this is an Elga Ace EHC-07 gateway and try again.
error.handshake_failed: The gateway did not accept the BLE/CAN/appliance handshake. Keep service mode active and check the Home Assistant logs.
error.unsupported_adapter: This transport cannot perform pairing. Use local Linux/BlueZ or update an active ESPHome proxy with the supplied built-in passkey configuration.
error.unknown: An unexpected error occurred. Check the Home Assistant logs.

abort.already_configured: This Bluetooth gateway is already configured.
abort.no_devices_found: No unconfigured connectable GTW/EHC gateways were found. Check service mode and your local adapter or active ESPHome proxy, then start setup again.
abort.not_supported: This is not a supported connectable GTW/EHC gateway.
abort.reauth_successful: The pairing code was updated. The integration is reconnecting.

init.title: Elga Ace polling and device name
init.description: Core measurements refresh every polling interval. Other registers rotate in bounded batches. All catalog entities stay available in the entity registry; unsupported registers remain unavailable.

data.name: Device name
data.slow_batch_size: Maximum background register reads per cycle

data_description.scan_interval: 20-300 seconds. Default: 30. Each cycle has a 15-second read budget.
data_description.slow_batch_size: 1-60. Default: 20. Initial population of the full catalog takes several minutes. Parameters are refreshed at most once every ten minutes.

error.invalid_name: Enter a device name between 1 and 80 characters.
